=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/self_heal_validation.sh: lines 308-327 (run_self_heal_codex), lines 408-417 and 473-483 (case statements) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: run_self_heal_codex() unconditionally routes the model call through untrusted_process_sandbox.sh without wrapping it in the stall guard or heartbeat helpers. SELF_HEAL_STALL_STATE is initialized to the empty string at line 312 and is never updated, so the case/esac branches on lines 408-417 (zero-exit path) and 473-483 (non-zero-exit path) that test for "observed" and "killed" stall states are unreachable dead code. CODEX_STALL_GUARD_HELPER (line 88) and CODEX_HEARTBEAT_HELPER (line 87) are still defined but are never invoked for the model call.
  WHY: A hung codex process inside the sandbox can consume the full 240-minute job timeout without idle-stall detection, telemetry, or Stalled classification. The prior code had stall-guard-and-fallback wrapping for the non-target-ref path; the new code drops it entirely while retaining the downstream stall-state handlers that can never fire.
- .github/workflows/validate.yml: lines 760-761 (renderer dependency install), 851-852 (Semble install), 890-893 (Semble builder) | severity and confidence not stated
  PROBLEM: The env -i HOME="${HOME}" PATH="${PATH}" invocations strip HTTP_PROXY, HTTPS_PROXY, ALL_PROXY, and NO_PROXY environment variables.
  WHY: On self-hosted runners configured with proxy environment variables, pip install and Semble download can fail because the proxy configuration is lost. The Semble steps are continue-on-error: true and fail soft, but the renderer dependency step is not.

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/self_heal_validation.sh: 308-327 (run_self_heal_codex function body) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The run_self_heal_codex function calls untrusted_process_sandbox.sh directly. The previous version wrapped the same codex invocation in codex_stall_guard.sh (or codex_heartbeat.sh) to record idle-stall state; the rewrite removes both wrappers entirely. SELF_HEAL_STALL_STATE is initialized but never updated, so the downstream case statements (lines 408-417 and 473-483) handling the Stalled substate are unreachable.
  WHY: A hung codex process spawned inside the sandbox can run until the 240-minute job timeout without any idle-stall detection. Validation self-heal loses its bounded-stall telemetry, and the existing pre-rewrite invariant that hung calls surface a Stalled classification no longer holds. PR comment 5843416072 explicitly claimed the credentialless sandbox was "route[d] through the existing idle-stall guard", which the actual diff contradicts.
- .github/workflows/validate.yml: 760-763 (renderer pip install), 849-852 (install_semble.sh), 886-895 (build_semble_wrapper.sh) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The three invocations use `env -i HOME="${HOME}" PATH="${PATH}"` which strips ALL_PROXY, http_proxy, https_proxy, no_proxy and any other proxy-related variables.
  WHY: On a self-hosted runner that depends on environment-variable proxy settings, pip cannot reach PyPI and install_semble.sh / build_semble_wrapper.sh cannot fetch their payloads. The renderer step would emit a `::warning::` and skip template rendering, and Semble installation would silently fail closed, so validation runs against a degraded harness.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- scripts/self_heal_validation.sh: run_self_heal_codex() at lines 308-327; SELF_HEAL_STALL_STATE assignment at line 312; case statements at lines 408-417 and 473-483; CODEX_STALL_GUARD_HELPER and CODEX_HEARTBEAT_HELPER defined at lines 87-88 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: run_self_heal_codex() calls untrusted_process_sandbox.sh directly without wrapping it in codex_stall_guard.sh or codex_heartbeat.sh. SELF_HEAL_STALL_STATE is set to empty at line 312 and never updated by any code path, making both case statements (lines 408-417 and 473-483) dead code. The sandbox script itself provides no stall detection (confirmed by grep -- no stall/heartbeat references in untrusted_process_sandbox.sh).
  WHY: A hung codex process in self-heal will run until the 240-minute job timeout with no idle-stall detection, no codex_stall_observed/codex_stall_killed telemetry, and no Stalled substate classification. The previous code had three fallback paths (stall guard, heartbeat, bare codex) that detected idle hangs; the new code has none. The case branches that handle stall outcomes are unreachable.
- .github/workflows/validate.yml: Lines 760-763 (renderer dependency install), lines 851-855 (Semble install and import check), lines 890-894 (Semble builder) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The env -i HOME="${HOME}" PATH="${PATH}" invocations discard HTTP_PROXY, HTTPS_PROXY, ALL_PROXY, and NO_PROXY environment variables. A prior editor round identified this and attempted to retain proxy variables (PR comment entry[6]) but the changes were never committed (entry[7] confirms "editor changes lost").
  WHY: On self-hosted runners behind a corporate proxy, pip install will fail to reach PyPI (renderer dependencies skipped, validation proceeds without rendered templates) and install_semble.sh will fail to download the Semble package. The failure is silent for the renderer (the step has a fallback warning) but causes Semble-dependent validation prompts to lose Semble context.
